page.overview:
Who is Gab?

"Howling" Gab is one of the Senior Officers of the Red Hair Pirates.

Gab is a large dark-skinned man with shaggy dark brown hair, small beard and pointy teeth giving him a lion-like appearance. In Marineford, he wore what looked like a brown cape. He is also shown wearing a backpack and white t-shirt during the events of the From the Decks of the World: The 500,000,000 Man Arc. In the Elbaph Arc, he wears a cloak.

Gab is a kind person at heart and a little timid. He hates bugs and ghosts.

Gab is a Senior Officer of the Red Hair Pirates, giving him authority over lower-ranking members of the crew. Gab is a powerful individual himself, considering how Marine Commodore Brannew described the whole crew as having a high average of bounties.
